steps.action: Install this release from the Bazaar, open the app details page, and use Upgrade Pearls so the Domain Template grain carrying the prepared account-opening launch moves to this version.
steps.expectedResult: The store pin, app index and grain package all report this release. The upgrade uses the rendered store control; no direct method call or side-load is an acceptable substitute.

steps.action: As the grain administrator, open /admin/register-participant on a Domain Template grain that has a signed, prepared account-opening launch with no enrollment receipt.
steps.expectedResult: A 'Prepared launches awaiting a receipt' row renders with the exact participant, case, correlation and 64-hex request digest. The row is derived from the signed launch journal; it must not be reconstructed from form input.

steps.action: NEGATIVE CONTROL — before using Resume, select the same portal in 'Launch account opening', fill every required field, and click 'Launch account opening'.
steps.expectedResult: The page refuses it with 'participant already has a prepared launch awaiting a receipt; resume request <the exact digest shown in the row>'. The prepared row remains the only launch, and Popaye receives no second enrollment call.

steps.action: Click 'Resume prepared launch' for the exact no-receipt launch whose corrected three-hook document was rejected because its 15-minute validity window had already expired.
steps.expectedResult: The page reports an accepted enrollment receipt and reload removes that prepared row. Read-only signed-journal evidence shows the existing RouterDescription, ProcessTemplateSourceDescription and SourceObjectID, case, correlation, EnrollmentRequest and ConfigRevisionDigest remain byte-identical; exactly one current ProcessTemplateDocument candidate is appended before the RPC with issuedAt at retry time and expiry at min(retry+15 minutes, source expiry), and the receipt selects that candidate. No second router or launch file is created.

steps.action: Restart the Domain Template grain and the enrolled Popaye grain through the shell, reopen /admin/register-participant, then open Popaye's /account-opening page.
steps.expectedResult: The prepared row stays gone after the Domain Template restart. Popaye boots normally and shows 'Waiting for your identity handoff' rather than system_down. Enrollment is durable, but it is not activation and still awaits the initial NamedCoin application outcome.

steps.action: NEGATIVE CONTROL — in a browser session that can open the shared grain but is not its administrator, attempt to open /admin/register-participant.
steps.expectedResult: The page is refused as forbidden, no enrolment or launch control renders, and the signed launch journal remains unchanged.

launchProbe.expectedResult: The exact existing prepared account-opening launch recovers through the visible Resume control using a current signed process document, while immutable router/source-description/request scope remains fixed and duplicate and non-admin UI paths remain refused.
